entities.summary: Aletheia University is a private university in Tamsui, New Taipei City. It has additional campuses in Madou and Tainan. It was founded by George Leslie Mackay as Oxford College. It has close links to the Presbyterian Church in Taiwan, and is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in Taiwan.
